title: AI Business Intelligence Platform
description: An AI-powered platform for analysing complex business datasets, uncovering real-time trends, and auto-generating executive summaries.
detailedDescription: Designed for enterprise data analysts, this platform integrates automated dataset parsing, real-time metric calculation, and generative AI summarization. Users can connect their CSV or SQL databases, ask natural-language questions, and receive publication-ready charts and actionable insights within seconds.

title: Enterprise Logistics & Fleet Tracker
description: Real-time dispatch, route optimization, and live telematics dashboard built for regional logistics providers.
detailedDescription: A mission-critical fleet management solution handling 500+ active commercial vehicles. Features sub-second telemetry updates, geospatial fence notifications, fuel efficiency analysis, and driver performance logging.

title: Cloud IDE & Developer Code Workspace
description: In-browser collaborative code editor featuring instant runtime execution, live syntax linting, and Git synchronization.
detailedDescription: Engineered for development teams and coding bootcamps, this cloud workspace brings full VS Code style capabilities to the web browser. Supports multi-file project workspaces, virtual terminals, and instant preview sandboxes.

title: Smart Hospital Management System
description: Modern healthcare portal streamlining patient triage, OPD queues, electronic health records (EHR), and billing.
detailedDescription: A HIPAA-compliant clinical administration suite providing digital patient onboarding, physician appointment calendars, automated diagnostic lab dispatch, and pharmacy inventory replenishment workflows.

title: High-Throughput Inventory Engine
description: Enterprise desktop and server utility built in Java for high-speed barcode scanning, warehouse reconciliation, and accounting sync.
detailedDescription: Engineered for manufacturing and wholesale hubs, this application processes tens of thousands of stock transactions per second with transactional ACID guarantees, PDF manifest generation, and offline replication.

title: Automated Document Vision & OCR Extractor
description: Deep learning microservice scanning invoices, IDs, and contracts to extract structured key-value data with 99.4% precision.
detailedDescription: Solves manual data entry for financial firms by combining computer vision document de-warping with transformer-based visual question answering, directly syncing structured JSON outputs into ERP systems.
